correction: Accept byte-pinned stable writable cold inputs without chmod. No output readonly, provenance, original-key, UID/inode or CI path gate changed.
limits: Synthetic CI environment only; root independently reviews and integrates actual CI.
Ordinary quiescent POSIX CI, not same-user adversarial filesystem or remote CI attestation.
